scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @woko/api" "npm run dev -w @woko/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @woko/domain && npm run build -w @woko/api && npm run build -w @woko/web
scripts.access:check: npm run build -w @woko/domain && node --import tsx node_modules/mws-central-auth/dist/access/bin.js check
scripts.access:doctor: npm run build -w @woko/domain && node --import tsx node_modules/mws-central-auth/dist/access/bin.js doctor
